title: Naran-Kaghan Getaway
summary: Four days from Lahore in the Kaghan valley: Lake Saiful Muluk by jeep, Lulusar Lake and the view from Babusar Top.
transport: Coaster, with jeeps to Saiful Muluk

image.alt: Lake Saiful Muluk lying still, mirroring green slopes and the snowy peaks above it

overview.headline: Four days in the Kaghan valley, its lakes and its high pass
paragraphs: We drive up the Kaghan valley along the Kunhar River to Naran, our base for three nights. From there it is a short jeep ride to Lake Saiful Muluk under Malika Parbat.
On the third day we go higher, past Lulusar Lake to Babusar Top, where the road tops out at over 4,000 metres before we come back down for dinner.
suitedTo: Families who want mountain lakes without long drives each day
Friends and couples on a short summer break
Travellers who prefer one hotel for the whole trip
notSuitedTo: Anyone travelling outside June to September, when the upper valley is closed
Travellers who find jeep tracks uncomfortable; the Saiful Muluk road is rough

highlights.title: Lulusar Lake
highlights.text: A long jade lake at the head of the valley

image.alt: Jade-green Lulusar Lake sits between grassy mountain slopes under billowing clouds, with pink wildflowers on the rocky shore.

highlights.title: Babusar Top
highlights.text: The road tops out at over 4,000 metres

image.alt: The Babusar road snakes down a green valley in tight hairpins from the pass, between grassy slopes and distant ridges.

highlights.title: Kunhar River
highlights.text: The river you follow all the way up the valley

image.alt: The broad Kunhar River flows past gravel bars between steep pine-covered slopes toward a distant peak.

itinerary.title: Lahore → Naran
itinerary.text: North on the motorway, then up the Kaghan valley along the Kunhar River to Naran.

itinerary.title: Lake Saiful Muluk
itinerary.text: A short jeep ride up to the lake under Malika Parbat, with the afternoon free in Naran.

itinerary.title: Lulusar and Babusar Top
itinerary.text: Up the valley past Lulusar Lake to Babusar Top, at over 4,000 metres, then back down for dinner.

itinerary.title: Naran → Lahore
itinerary.text: Down the Kaghan valley and home on the motorway by evening.
